stories.title: Fresno City College's food pantry supports students as food costs rise
stories.summary: As inflation continues to drive up the cost of basic necessities, more California families are turning to food banks and pantries for support.

stories.title: Offer Kindness nonprofit donates thousands of fresh produce from Valley farmers unable to sell
stories.summary: Offer Kindness is a Valley volunteer-driven initiative that provides fresh produce and fruit from local farmworkers and homeowners who are unable to sell their crops.

stories.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins US Senate race in Alaska, beating incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan
stories.summary: Democrat Mary Peltola has defeated two-term Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan in Alaska.

stories.title: New Hulu doc explores Derek and Hayley Hough's harrowing dance recovery journey
stories.summary: Watch the trailer for "The Symphony of Dance," Hulu's new documentary capturing Derek and Hayley Hough's incredible journey of recovery and resilience.

stories.title: 47-year-old man found dead in Tulare County canal identified
stories.summary: The man who was found dead in a canal in Tulare County has been identified as 47-year-old Ismael Garcia.

stories.title: Fresno County urging residents to get MMR vaccine after U.S. loses measles elimination status
stories.summary: Fresno County Public Health Department officials say they've seen a limited number of measles cases, but also declining vaccination rates.

stories.title: Fresno councilmembers-elect urge residents to oppose proposed water rate hikes
stories.summary: Councilmembers-elect Ariana Martinez Lott and Naindeep Singh have taken to social media to encourage residents to vote against the city's proposed water rate hikes. The two argue that the effort is being rushed and contend that the city already has healthy reserves.

stories.title: Meet Cashmere: Fresno County's Pet of the Month seeks forever home
stories.summary: A 6-year-old Alaskan Husky named Cashmere made a special appearance during Tuesday's Fresno County Board of Supervisors meeting as the county's featured Pet of the Month.

stories.title: AccuWeather Forecast
stories.summary: Watch the latest AccuWeather forecast on ABC30 Action News.

stories.title: Man gets nearly 30 years in prison for Trump, Biden assassination plot he said was steered from Iran
stories.summary: A man who admitted trying to get a U.S. politician killed — and said Iran's paramilitary Revolutionary Guard drove him to it — was sentenced Tuesday to nearly three decades in prison.

stories.title: White House pulls FDA nominee Heidi Overton after wavering support from Senate Republicans
stories.summary: The White House said Tuesday it has pulled the nomination of Dr. Heidi Overton to lead the Food and Drug Administration amid growing indications she didn't have the votes needed to win Senate confirmation.

stories.title: Accused killer tells jury shooting of family friend was accidental, claims self-defense
stories.summary: The defendant in a Fresno murder trial took the witness stand Tuesday, telling jurors he never intended to kill a longtime family friend and that the fatal shooting was the result of fear, confusion and an accidental discharge of his firearm.
